title: Login to the Hospital Management Portal
description: Allows unauthenticated users to log in to the system using their credentials.

steps.value: User navigates to the portal and lands on the login page.
User enters their registered email/username and password.
User clicks the 'Login' button.
If login is successful, the system checks the user's assigned roles.
subitems: If the user has a single role, they are redirected to the landing page for that role.
If the user has multiple roles, they are presented with a role selection screen (roleSelection scenario).

steps.value: If login fails due to incorrect credentials, an error message is displayed.
User can choose to 'Forgot Password' or 'Sign Up'.

title: Register for a new account
description: Allows new users to create an account and select their initial role (patient).

steps.value: User clicks 'Sign Up' from the login page.
User is presented with a registration form.
User enters required personal information such as name, email, and password.
User selects a role from a dropdown list. Only 'patient' role is available for self-signup.
User clicks the 'Register' button.
System sends a verification email to the user's registered email address.
User is redirected to a page instructing them to check their email for verification, with a note to check spam folder.

title: Request password reset
description: Allows users who have forgotten their password to initiate a password reset process.

steps.value: User clicks 'Forgot Password' from the login page.
User is prompted to enter their registered email address.
User clicks 'Submit' or 'Send Reset Link'.
System sends a password reset link to the provided email address.
User is redirected to a page instructing them to check their email for the reset link.

title: Set a new password
description: Allows users to set a new password after receiving a reset link via email.

steps.value: User receives a password reset email and clicks on the provided link.
User is directed to a 'Reset Password' page.
User enters and confirms a new password, ensuring it meets complexity requirements.
User clicks 'Set New Password' button.
Upon successful password reset, the user is redirected to the login page with a success message.

title: Admin Dashboard Overview
description: Provides the administrator with a centralized view of key system metrics, quick access to management tools for users, appointments, reports, and system settings.

steps.value: Login leads to Admin Dashboard scenario.
The administrator views an overview dashboard displaying key metrics (e.g., number of active users, pending appointments, system health).
The dashboard provides navigation links or widgets to User Management, Appointment Oversight, Reporting & Analytics, System Configuration, Audit Logs, and Webhook Configuration.

title: Manage System Users
description: Allows administrators to view, create, edit, and deactivate user accounts (patients and doctors) and assign/modify their roles.

steps.value: From the Admin Dashboard, the administrator navigates to the User Management section.
The administrator views a list of all registered users in the system.
The administrator can search or filter users by name, role, or status.
To create a new user (e.g., a doctor or another admin), the administrator clicks 'Add New User'.
The administrator enters user details (name, email, password, etc.).
The administrator selects one or more roles for the new user (e.g., Doctor, Admin).
The administrator saves the new user account.
To edit an existing user, the administrator selects a user from the list and clicks 'Edit'.
The administrator modifies user details or assigned roles.
The administrator saves the changes.
To deactivate a user, the administrator selects a user and confirms deactivation.
To view user details, the administrator clicks on a user's entry.

title: Oversee All Appointment Activities
description: Provides administrators with a consolidated view of all appointment activities across the system, allowing for monitoring and management.

steps.value: From the Admin Dashboard, the administrator navigates to the Appointment Oversight section.
The administrator views a list of all appointments (scheduled, pending, completed, cancelled).
The administrator can filter appointments by doctor, patient, date range, or status.
The administrator can search for specific appointments.
The administrator can view details of any appointment, including patient, doctor, date, time, and status.
The administrator can change the status of an appointment (e.g., cancel, mark as complete) or reschedule it if necessary for administrative purposes.

title: Configure Hospital System Settings
description: Allows administrators to define and update hospital-specific settings such as operating hours, holidays, and general policies.

steps.value: From the Admin Dashboard, the administrator navigates to the System Configuration section.
The administrator views a list of configurable settings (e.g., operating hours, holiday calendar, default appointment durations, privacy policy links).
The administrator selects a setting to modify.
The administrator updates the value of the setting.
The administrator saves the changes to the system settings.

title: Generate and Export System Reports
description: Enables administrators to generate various reports on system metrics (appointments, user engagement, communication) and export them in different formats.

steps.value: From the Admin Dashboard, the administrator navigates to the Reporting & Analytics section.
The administrator views a list of available report types (e.g., Appointment Summary, User Activity, Communication Metrics).
The administrator selects a report type.
The administrator specifies report parameters (e.g., date range, specific doctor/patient, status filters).
The administrator clicks 'Generate Report'.
The system displays the generated report data.
The administrator can choose to export the report in CSV or PDF format.
The system initiates the download of the selected report file.

title: Review Comprehensive Audit Logs
description: Allows administrators to view and filter detailed audit logs for significant user actions, ensuring security and compliance.

steps.value: From the Admin Dashboard, the administrator navigates to the Audit Logs section.
The administrator views a chronological list of system events and user actions.
The administrator can filter logs by date range, user, action type (e.g., login, PHI access, record modification), or affected entity.
The administrator can search for specific log entries.
The administrator can view detailed information for each log entry, including timestamp, user, action, and outcome.

title: Manage Webhook Notifications
description: Enables administrators to configure and manage webhook notifications for external system integrations.

steps.value: From the Admin Dashboard, the administrator navigates to the Webhook Configuration section.
The administrator views a list of existing webhook configurations.
To add a new webhook, the administrator clicks 'Add New Webhook'.
The administrator specifies the webhook URL, trigger events (e.g., appointment status change, new message), and any authentication details.
The administrator saves the new webhook configuration.
To edit an existing webhook, the administrator selects a webhook and clicks 'Edit'.
The administrator modifies the webhook details.
The administrator saves the changes.
To delete a webhook, the administrator selects a webhook and confirms deletion.
The administrator can test a webhook configuration to ensure it's working correctly.

title: Utilize AI Assistant for Reporting
description: Allows administrators to interact with an AI assistant to generate custom reports and analyze operational data, providing insights into hospital operations.

steps.value: From the Admin Dashboard, the administrator navigates to the AI Assistant Interface.
The administrator initiates a conversation with the AI assistant.
The administrator requests a custom report or analysis (e.g., 'Show me appointment trends for the last quarter', 'Analyze user engagement for doctors').
The AI assistant processes the request, potentially asking for clarification or additional parameters.
The AI assistant presents the report or analysis results, possibly with options to export.

title: Patient Dashboard Overview
description: Provides the patient with a personalized overview of their health information, upcoming appointments, and quick access to health management tools.

steps.value: Login leads to Patient Dashboard scenario.
The patient views an overview dashboard displaying upcoming appointments, recent medical records, and unread messages.
The dashboard provides navigation links or widgets to manage their profile, schedule appointments, access medical records, send secure messages, and manage consents.

title: Manage Personal Profile
description: Allows patients to view and update their personal information, contact details, and other relevant profile data securely.

steps.value: From the Patient Dashboard, the patient navigates to the 'My Profile' section.
The patient views their current personal details, contact information, and other profile attributes.
The patient can edit editable fields such as address, phone number, and email.
The patient saves the changes to their profile.

title: Schedule a New Appointment
description: Enables patients to search for doctors, check their availability, and book new appointments.

steps.value: From the Patient Dashboard, the patient navigates to the 'Schedule Appointment' section.
The patient can search for doctors by specialty, name, or availability.
The patient views a list of available doctors and their schedules.
The patient selects a preferred doctor, date, and time slot.
The patient provides a reason for the visit and any relevant notes.
The patient reviews the appointment details and confirms the booking request.
The system provides confirmation of the appointment request submission.

title: View and Manage My Appointments
description: Allows patients to view their scheduled, pending, and past appointments, and manage (reschedule/cancel) upcoming ones.

steps.value: From the Patient Dashboard, the patient navigates to the 'My Appointments' section.
The patient views a list of all their appointments, categorized by upcoming, pending, and past.
The patient can filter or sort appointments by date, doctor, or status.
The patient selects an upcoming appointment to view its details.
For an upcoming appointment, the patient has options to reschedule or cancel the appointment.
The patient confirms the reschedule or cancellation action.

title: Access My Medical Records and Visit Summaries
description: Provides patients secure access to their personal medical history, diagnoses, treatments, and visit summaries.

steps.value: From the Patient Dashboard, the patient navigates to the 'Medical Records' section.
The patient views a chronological list of their medical records and visit summaries.
The patient can filter or search for specific records.
The patient selects a record to view detailed information, including diagnosis, treatment, prescriptions, and doctor's notes.
The patient has the option to download or print selected medical records.

title: Secure Messaging with My Doctor
description: Enables patients to send and receive secure, confidential messages with their assigned doctors.

steps.value: From the Patient Dashboard, the patient navigates to the 'Secure Messages' section.
The patient views a list of their message conversations with assigned doctors.
The patient selects a conversation to view the message history.
The patient can compose and send a new message to an assigned doctor.
The patient receives notifications for new incoming messages.

title: Manage My Data Rights
description: Allows patients to request access, correction, or deletion of their personal and medical data in compliance with privacy laws.

steps.value: From the Patient Dashboard, the patient navigates to the 'Data Rights Management' section.
The patient views options to request data access, correction, or deletion.
The patient selects an option (e.g., 'Request Data Access').
The patient fills out a form specifying the details of their request.
The patient submits the request.
The patient can view the status and history of their submitted data rights requests.

title: Manage My Consents
description: Enables patients to review and manage their consent for various legal policies (e.g., Terms of Use, Privacy Policy) and data usage.

steps.value: From the Patient Dashboard, the patient navigates to the 'Consent Management' section.
The patient views a list of legal policies (e.g., Terms of Use, Privacy Policy) and data usage consents.
The patient can review the details of each consent.
The patient can grant or revoke consent for specific items, where applicable.
The patient confirms their consent choices.
The patient views a history of their consent decisions.

title: Utilize AI Assistant for Patient Self-Service
description: Allows patients to interact with an AI assistant for self-service tasks like appointment scheduling, information retrieval, and general portal navigation.

steps.value: From the Patient Dashboard, the patient navigates to the 'AI Assistant' interface.
The patient initiates a conversation with the AI assistant.
The patient asks a question or requests a task (e.g., 'Schedule an appointment,' 'What are my upcoming appointments?', 'Summarize my last visit.').
The AI assistant processes the request, potentially asking for clarification or additional parameters.
The AI assistant provides information or guides the patient through the requested task (e.g., presents available appointment slots, displays a summary of medical records).

title: Doctor Dashboard Overview
description: Provides doctors with a centralized view of their clinical schedule, pending appointment requests, and quick access to patient records and secure messages.

steps.value: Login leads to Doctor Dashboard scenario.
The doctor views an overview dashboard displaying their upcoming clinical schedule, pending appointment requests, and unread secure messages.
The dashboard provides navigation links or widgets to manage their schedule, review appointment requests, access patient medical records, and send secure messages.

title: Manage Clinical Schedule and Availability
description: Allows doctors to define their working hours, block specific time slots for non-patient activities, and view their confirmed appointments.

steps.value: From the Doctor Dashboard, the doctor navigates to the 'My Schedule' section.
The doctor views their current clinical schedule, including working hours and blocked time slots.
The doctor can set or modify their regular working hours for different days of the week.
The doctor can block specific time slots for breaks, meetings, or personal time.
The doctor can view a list of all their confirmed appointments.

title: Review and Respond to Patient Appointment Requests
description: Enables doctors to review incoming appointment requests from patients, examine details, and either approve or decline them.

steps.value: From the Doctor Dashboard, the doctor navigates to the 'Pending Appointment Requests' section.
The doctor views a list of all new and pending appointment requests from patients.
The doctor selects an appointment request to view its details, including patient information, requested date/time, and reason for visit.
The doctor can choose to 'Approve' the appointment request.
The doctor can choose to 'Decline' the appointment request, providing a reason for the decline.
The system updates the appointment status and notifies the patient.

title: View and Update Assigned Patient Medical Records
description: Allows doctors to securely access, view, and update the medical records of patients assigned to them, including adding diagnoses, treatments, prescriptions, and clinical notes.

steps.value: From the Doctor Dashboard, the doctor navigates to the 'My Patients' or 'Patient Records' section.
The doctor views a list of patients assigned to them.
The doctor selects a patient to view their comprehensive medical record history.
The doctor can view details of past visits, diagnoses, treatments, prescriptions, and clinical notes.
To update a record, the doctor selects an existing record or initiates a new entry (e.g., after a consultation).
The doctor adds new diagnoses, treatments, prescriptions, or clinical notes.
The doctor saves the updates to the patient's medical record.

title: Secure Messaging with Patients
description: Enables doctors to send and receive secure, confidential messages with their assigned patients, facilitating direct communication.

steps.value: From the Doctor Dashboard, the doctor navigates to the 'Secure Messages' section.
The doctor views a list of their message conversations with patients.
The doctor selects a conversation to view the message history.
The doctor can compose and send a new message to an assigned patient.
The doctor receives notifications for new incoming messages from patients.

title: Utilize AI Assistant for Doctor Workflow
description: Allows doctors to interact with an AI assistant to manage their schedule, quickly retrieve patient information summaries, and draft responses to patient messages.

steps.value: From the Doctor Dashboard, the doctor navigates to the 'AI Assistant' interface.
The doctor initiates a conversation with the AI assistant.
The doctor asks a question or requests a task (e.g., 'Show me my schedule for tomorrow', 'Summarize patient John Doe's last visit', 'Draft a response to patient Jane Smith about her lab results').
The AI assistant processes the request, potentially asking for clarification or additional parameters.
The AI assistant provides information or guides the doctor through the requested task (e.g., displays schedule, presents patient summary, drafts message).

title: Select Application Role
description: Allows an authenticated user with multiple assigned application roles to select which role they want to operate under for the current session.

steps.value: Login leads to Role Selection scenario if the user has multiple assigned roles.
The user is presented with a list of application roles they are assigned to (e.g., Patient, Doctor).
The user selects one of the available roles.
Upon selection, the user is redirected to the landing dashboard specific to the chosen role (e.g., Patient Dashboard, Doctor Dashboard).
